entries.description:
Overshock
At max Electric Surge, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill Overshock, dealing Electro DMG.
Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Normal Attack Stage 4.
This skill can be cast in mid-air.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by the button, clear all Electric Surge to grant Resonators in the team 10% ATK Bonus for 20s.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by holding down the button, consume 60 of Concerto Energy to deal damage, then clear all Electric Surge to enter Apex Resonance.
Apex Resonance
While in Apex Resonance, Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds is unlocked, which consumes 10% Thunder Rage per second:
While on the ground, Resonance Skill to launch up to 7 consecutive attacks:
- The first 3: Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro, dealing Spectro DMG.
- The next 3: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The last 1: Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade, dealing Aero DMG.
While on the ground, hold Resonance Skill to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero, dealing Aero DMG and leaping into the air.
While airborne, Resonance Skill to perform up to 6 stages of Mid-air Attacks:
- The first 3: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc Mid-air Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The next 2: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Mid-air Attack, dealing Aero DMG and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The last 1: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG. Resonance Skill shortly after landing to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade.
Hold Resonance Skill in mid-air to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack.
Each time Thrum of All Sounds hits the target, Thunder Bane is triggered, dealing Electro DMG to the target within range, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
While in Apex Resonance, Resonance Skill shortly after casting a Basic Attack to chain into a specific Thrum of All Sounds skill based on the different Basic Attack Stages.
Electric Surge
Rover can hold up to 120 points of Electric Surge.
Electric Surge is restored when Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, Normal Attack - Deterrence, Resonance Skill - Thunderclap, or Basic Attack - Repel deals damage.
Thunder Rage
Rover can hold up to 100 points of Thunder Rage.
Entering Apex Resonance restores Thunder Rage to the max limit.
Thunder Rage is restored when Thrum of All Sounds deals damage.
